title: Iraqi Kurdistan's Barzani Meets Syrian President al-Sharaa in Damascus — First Such Visit Since Assad's Fall
detail: August 3, 2026 — Iraqi Kurdistan Region President Nechirvan Barzani met Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa in Damascus, the first visit by an Iraqi Kurdish leader to Syria since Assad's fall in December 2024. The two discussed SDF integration into national institutions, Kurdish constitutional guarantees, border security, management of ISIS-detainee camps, and reopening Syria's consulate in Erbil — all components of Syria's broader post-Assad political transition.

title: Maduro, From US Custody, Backs Venezuela's Government-Opposition Talks
detail: August 3, 2026 — Nicolás Maduro, in US custody since his January 3, 2026 capture on narco-terrorism charges, issued a statement calling for August to be a month of 'sincere dialogue,' backing the government-opposition democracy talks that had begun days earlier in Caracas under acting president Delcy Rodríguez.
